bounded_completion_criteria.definition: For a declared computation domain, an account is operationally complete when input formation, sufficient state, every update and finite profile are explicitly bound; its own-state predictions and declared interventions close through actual consumers; and unqualified conditions or misses are named. Evidence supports that bounded account, not all possible inputs or hardware.
bounded_completion_criteria.already_closed: Core raw-to-image formation and consumed continuation in the tested source/profile, plus specific controlled input-route and finite-dispatch explanations.
bounded_completion_criteria.remaining: Transfer of the newly proposed local sign relation, portable/reusable naming and applicability rather than one law ID per specimen, and any concrete unresolved profile/consumer miss.

bounded_completion_criteria.stopping_rule: After the fixed transfer panel, publish its qualified domain and misses. Do not automatically enlarge the cohort or regenerate full images. Choose another run only for a named unresolved state/update/consumer/applicability question.
